adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the diff switches membership removal logic to `group.users.delete(user_id)`. For `has_many :through` associations this performs a direct delete of join rows (typically `delete_all`) and does not instantiate/destroy the join model, so any join-model `destroy` callbacks or counter-cache updates that would have happened via the prior `group.remove(user)` path (seen in the removed `update_patch`) will be skipped. This can plausibly leave derived state (e.g., cached counts or cleanup side effects) inconsistent after removal.
